model.name: canonGuard.assertNoSchemeLiteralInSource
model.description: Scan generator SOURCE (src/ + scripts/*.ts) for a HARDCODED bespoke-scheme literal (R-C<n> / task-c<n> / Task C<n>) — a generator ASSERTING the dead scheme -> RED. check-altid-canon inspects UNITS; it structurally could NOT catch a scheme literal in source, which is exactly where the board-drift defect lived (the overview index hardcoded 'R-C1 pin + R-C5 rollup'). EXCLUDES: the INV-C<n> invariant-ID namespace (different namespace, renaming = code change with test/gate fallout), comment-only lines, and the guard file itself.
